_comment_auth: NTUCOOL doesn't support personal access tokens. 'chrome' mode reads your session cookie straight out of local Chrome (no password, no copy/paste) and only works when this script runs on your own machine. 'cookie' is the manual fallback. 'token' is for Canvas instances that DO support personal access tokens.
_comment_telegram: Optional. Leave both blank ('') to skip Telegram entirely — the dashboard, refresh, and CLI --list still work fine; only the notify button/hourly reminder are skipped.
